reviewSamples.author: Photo of Natalie Eguizabal
reviewSamples.text: Seriously one of the BEST AC companies around in the south Florida area. Max has an incredible knowledge of all AC units, and stands out among his competitors because he is genuine and honest. We got a variety of quotes and were lied to by others on unnecessary repairs. He gave me a very fair price and explained all the options we had. He was able to guide us on improvements we can do in the future, and helped us prioritize which upgrades we should do in our house based on our budget. Excellent service, excellent owner! I will definitely recommend this company to EVERYONE I know! So happy to do business with Max!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Adena L
reviewSamples.text: After a summer from hell with my AC (which started working poorly June 26th and wasn’t fixed until October), Max and his team came to the rescue, quickly assessed the issues and resolved promptly. Prior to this, we had at least 3 other companies, including the company who had sold me the units 3 years ago, come to my home over 8 times with no resolution. Mostly everyone else was looking for a big job and costly repairs that were not necessary in the end. In what I assume is a very competitive industry in Miami, integrity is the difference maker and Max and his team have it and they do a great job!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of ORLY PAZ
reviewSamples.text: I highly recommend this company. From the moment I made my appointment till the job was complete they have been prompt and professional. They always pick up the phone or respond quickly to any calls. The tech  Max was quick and very polite. He completed the job fast and it was done properly. If you have home improvement, Ac, plumbing or electrical needs definitely call them you’ll be happy you did

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Viviana Batista Perenzin
reviewSamples.text: The Home Pros team did a great job installing my new AC and all new ductwork. Their pricing was reasonable and their service was superb. I had a room in my home that was always warm and now it's ice cold in there, so two thumbs up! I highly recommend using them for your HVAC needs.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kimberly Black
reviewSamples.text: Max is a greedy, liar and cheater. I had been with the company for about 3 years ( about $15, 000 worth of work between my rental properties) until I realized max was now running the business and everything had changed. home pros hvac split from home pros plumbing and is now run by max ( previously brothers John and Jose) . Home pros plumbing is still an excellent, trustworthy  company but RUN AWAY from home pros hvac. Max is a fraud.
